name: Tags::EditModal
description: A modal that edits the tags of one record: chips with remove buttons and an input that adds an existing or a new project tag. Changes are staged and applied on Save.

projectId.description: The project whose tags are suggested and created

relatedTo.description: The record type: issue or conversationroom

title.description: Translation key of the modal title

titleParams.description: Values for the title translation, e.g. the issue number

onClose.description: The modal closed, by Save, Cancel, the close button or Esc; the caller removes it

onSaved.description: All staged changes were applied, before the modal closes
